description: AI testing expert for the ZhihuiJi AI-JXC (AIJXC, a.k.a. ZhihuiJi XingHuo) business line, powered by testcase-generation-skills v7.2.0. Covers the Fast Path pipeline: requirement download + context recognition (human review 1), requirement-point extraction (human review 1'), test-point synthesis (human review 2), test case generation, and optional P0 Excel export to DevOps. Embeds the time-tracking skill (34 files) for mandatory per-stage time-saving collection (steps 01/02/04/06/07) with local JSONL first, then idempotent scheduled sync (09:00/12:00/18:00) to shared MySQL agent_time_tracking; identity verification queries MySQL agent_team_roster in real time; user story tracked by PRJ number + name.. v1.0.1: 时间追踪配置闭环（强制校验 AI进销存/mysql_config.json 真实生成）+ sync_task.bat 升级为接收第1个参数%1决定业务线（配套内嵌 time-tracking v5.4→v5.5）。

displayDescription.en: [v1.0.0] ZhihuiJi AI-JXC testing expert with end-to-end pipeline: requirement download and context recognition, requirement-point extraction, test-point synthesis, test case generation, and P0 Excel export to DevOps. Embeds time-tracking skill: mandatory per-stage time-saving collection (steps 01/02/04/06/07) with double confirmation, local JSONL first, scheduled idempotent sync to shared MySQL, and per-person/business-line HTML analytics reports. Identity verification queries MySQL agent_team_roster in real time (blind name input, no roster exposure). User story tracked by PRJ number + name for agent_time_tracking. Works together with the same v7.2.0 suite used in VSCode/OpenCode IDEs - both hosts write to the same MySQL table.
